rules.statement: Ancient sowing extent of grain and modern measurement of actual extent of land cannot be compared per se due to numerous other factors.
rules.supporting_quote: We are of the view, that the ancient and traditional sowing extent of grain and the modern measurement of actual extent of land cannot be compared per se since numerous other factors (i.e., the terrain, the fertility of the soil, size and quality of the grain and various modes and methods of cultivation) have a bearing on the sowing extent.
